{
  "action": "rewrite",
  "sentences": [
    "The graph shows the same data as before, with post-January results.",
    "Conservatives drop sharply from about 43% to 44% to roughly 37% to 38%.",
    "The decline for Conservatives is about 6 points.",
    "Liberals surge from around 20% to 21% to about 42% to 43%.",
    "The increase for Liberals is about 21 to 22 points.",
    "NDP falls from roughly 18% to 19% to near 8% to 9%.",
    "The decline for NDP is about 10 points.",
    "Bloc Québécois eases slightly from about 8% to 9% to 6% to 7%.",
    "Greens decline from around 4% to about 2% to 3%.",
    "Overall, the new data shows a rapid realignment.",
    "This realignment is driven primarily by a large shift from NDP and Conservative support toward the Liberals."
  ]
}

Simplify this claim into complete, easy-to-parse sentences without changing its meaning, even if the claim is false. Prefer splitting complex structure; use one sentence when completing a fragment is enough. Repeat exact participant names and identifiers. State each condition once.
Preserve numbers, units, ranges, dates, tense/aspect, negation, uncertainty, alternatives, goals and who did what to whom. A planned event is not an achieved event. Never infer a signer from a signed object or guess an ambiguous reference. Keep quoted text exactly in one source sentence; do not expand its internal events into assertions. Depicted and reported content must retain its context. Do not introduce positive audio/narration under an absence claim.
Example: "A photo of Alice holding a blue cup." becomes ["A photo depicts Alice.", "Alice is holding a blue cup."]. The holding remains depicted content; do not duplicate the cup color as an extra sentence.
Return JSON with action (rewrite, keep, refuse) and sentences. For rewrite return one to twelve simpler sentences. Return an empty list for keep/refuse. Keep an already clear atomic claim; refuse when simplification requires guessing. Return no IDs, links, predicates, explanations or scores. The supplied dependency/SRL parses can be wrong.

Simplify this claim into complete, easy-to-parse sentences without changing its meaning, even if the claim is false. Prefer splitting complex structure; use one sentence when completing a fragment is enough. Repeat exact participant names and identifiers. State each condition once.
Preserve numbers, units, ranges, dates, tense/aspect, negation, uncertainty, alternatives, goals and who did what to whom. A planned event is not an achieved event. Never infer a signer from a signed object or guess an ambiguous reference. Keep quoted text exactly in one source sentence; do not expand its internal events into assertions. Depicted and reported content must retain its context. Do not introduce positive audio/narration under an absence claim.
Example: "A photo of Alice holding a blue cup." becomes ["A photo depicts Alice.", "Alice is holding a blue cup."]. The holding remains depicted content; do not duplicate the cup color as an extra sentence.
Return JSON with action (rewrite, keep, refuse) and sentences. For rewrite return one to twelve simpler sentences. Return an empty list for keep/refuse. Keep an already clear atomic claim; refuse when simplification requires guessing. Return no IDs, links, predicates, explanations or scores. The supplied dependency/SRL parses can be wrong.
